socketRule: 1 permanent Runestone socket per Weapon and Body Armor; socketing overwrites and destroys the previous Runestone with zero extraction.

weaponPrefixes.name: Blazing
weaponPrefixes.effect: Strikes deal bonus Fire damage (+12%–25%), splash 35% to an adjacent enemy, and chance to Burn.

weaponPrefixes.name: Glacial
weaponPrefixes.effect: Strikes deal bonus Frost damage (+12%–25%) and apply Chill, pushing targets back on the timeline.

weaponPrefixes.name: Arcing
weaponPrefixes.effect: Strikes deal bonus Lightning damage (+12%–25%) that chains to a 2nd enemy with a Shock chance.

weaponPrefixes.name: Venomous
weaponPrefixes.effect: Strikes deal bonus Poison damage (+12%–25%); poisoned foes deal 10%–18% less physical damage.

weaponPrefixes.name: Hallowed
weaponPrefixes.effect: Strikes deal bonus Radiant damage (+15%–32% vs. Undead & Portal Horrors) and purge 1 enemy buff on crit.

weaponPrefixes.name: Detonating
weaponPrefixes.effect: Hitting an enemy suffering Burn, Bleed, or Poison detonates 25%–50% of remaining over-time damage immediately.

weaponPrefixes.name: Vampiric
weaponPrefixes.effect: Attacks & skills heal the user for 8%–18% of damage dealt.

weaponPrefixes.name: Siphoning
weaponPrefixes.effect: Attacks & skills restore 2–7 MP per hit (doubled on Weakness or Critical hits).

weaponPrefixes.name: Crushing
weaponPrefixes.effect: 0 MP Attack Modes chip +1 extra Guard point and lower enemy Defense by 10%–22% for 2 turns.

weaponPrefixes.name: Rending
weaponPrefixes.effect: Weapon Critical Hits inflict heavy Bleed (3 turns) and deal +15%–32% bonus damage vs. Bleeding foes.

weaponPrefixes.name: Executioner's
weaponPrefixes.effect: Deal +20%–42% bonus weapon damage to enemies below 40% HP or Staggered.

weaponPrefixes.name: Echoing
weaponPrefixes.effect: 15%–32% chance for single-target 0 MP attacks to strike a second time at 50% power.

armorPrefixes.name: Bastion's
armorPrefixes.effect: Enter every battle with a protective Ward Shield (12%–30% Max HP).

armorPrefixes.name: Retaliating
armorPrefixes.effect: Reflect 18%–38% of incoming melee damage back onto attackers and chip 1 Guard point when hit while Battered.

armorPrefixes.name: Resolve-Heart
armorPrefixes.effect: Gain +18%–38% damage & healing potency whenever HP is below 50% (Battered).

armorPrefixes.name: Sanctified
armorPrefixes.effect: Gain 25%–60% resistance to all Status Ailments & Stun, and heal 3%–6% HP when an ailment fails or expires.

armorPrefixes.name: Vanguard's
armorPrefixes.effect: Taking the Guard action restores 6%–15% Max HP + 4–10 MP and pushes your next turn forward on the timeline.

armorPrefixes.name: Unbreakable
armorPrefixes.effect: Once per battle, survive a fatal hit at 1 HP and immediately gain a 10%–25% Ward Shield.

armorPrefixes.name: Overflowing
armorPrefixes.effect: Excess healing above 100% Max HP converts into a protective Ward Shield (up to 15%–30% Max HP).

armorPrefixes.name: Phantom's
armorPrefixes.effect: Gain +6%–16% Dodge Chance, and dodging an attack immediately grants Momentum (+25% next hit).

armorPrefixes.name: Adaptive
armorPrefixes.effect: Taking elemental/magic damage grants a 25%–55% resistance barrier against that element for 2 turns.

armorPrefixes.name: Martyr's
armorPrefixes.effect: When an adjacent ally is hit below 40% HP, intercept 25%–40% of the hit with 15% damage reduction.

universalSuffixes.name: of Alacrity
universalSuffixes.effect: +3 to +14 Turn Timeline Speed & +3 to +12 opening battle Initiative.

universalSuffixes.name: of Piercing
universalSuffixes.effect: Attacks & spells ignore 10%–30% of enemy Physical & Magic Defense.

universalSuffixes.name: of Vitality
universalSuffixes.effect: +30 to +280 Max HP & recover 3%–8% HP after battle victories.

universalSuffixes.name: of the Magus
universalSuffixes.effect: +10 to +90 Max MP & -5% to -15% spell/remedy MP cost.

universalSuffixes.name: of Momentum
universalSuffixes.effect: Landing a kill or Critical Hit grants Momentum (+25% next hit or spell).

universalSuffixes.name: of Mending
universalSuffixes.effect: +8% to +28% Healing & Shielding Power (both cast and received).

universalSuffixes.name: of Wisdom
universalSuffixes.effect: +2 to +16 Arcana & Presence & +6 to +65 Magic Defense.
